snippet.title: POLYCHROMIA - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Polychromia is a fresh take on logic puzzles where one tries to blend colors together on a grid and make flowers bloom. 
Simple yet challenging puzzles, along with calm music and serene visuals, make for the perfect relaxing experience!
